title: How Do You Write a Persuasive Essay? — With Example
skills: develop a clear persuasive claim or position
organize reasons and evidence into a coherent essay structure
address audience and purpose when making an argument
use examples and supporting details to strengthen persuasive writing
alignment_note: Explains the structure and development of a persuasive essay, including forming a clear position, organizing reasons, supporting claims with evidence, and considering audience. Supports argument writing, rhetorical awareness, evidence use, organization, and academic essay development across high school English courses.
